# Rumors heard in Bellwether (the Marmot, the square, the temple soup line)
<!-- Roll 1d12, or pick. True / false / half as marked for the GM; players hear only the rumor. -->

| roll | result |
|------|--------|
| 1 | "The castle's been up there since this morning. Hawksmoor built it to fly and it flew, and now he can't get it down." (true) |
| 2 | "The goose-herder was crowned Winter King once, years ago, and never got over it." (half true: it was this morning, as far as anyone knows) |
| 3 | "There's a frost giant under the glacier. Drank the monastery dry on his way through and lay down to die." (true, except the dying) |
| 4 | "The satyrs on the lake dance every Midwinter until the ice gives. Nobody's seen it give." (half true) |
| 5 | "The Crown of Misrule used to have five jewels. Bastable had them taken out so nobody'd steal them." (false; he did not) |
| 6 | "The night watch at the North Gate drink the Marmot's ale and can't be woken before a quarter to seven. Bergmann's had words." (true) |
| 7 | "Old Fahrenheit's forecast has never once been wrong. He says so." (false, and he does say so) |
| 8 | "The passes will be open by noon." (false; the forecast) |
| 9 | "The First Winter King is buried under the temple, and he was a goose." (half true: there is a stone goose) |
| 10 | "If you point the goose-herder's grey rock at the Keep it goes red. He showed me. It's a trick with a candle." (true, and not a trick) |
| 11 | "Hob's Rest at the pass is snowed under, but there's smoke from it." (unknown; rumor; may be false) |
| 12 | "A reel you can't stop dancing to, a toast you can't finish, a song that won't end, and the worst headache in the world: that's the old Midwinter song, and it's about the Crown." (true, nine verses; Temperance or Fahrenheit has it) |
